activity_summary: Hobbins was nine days on the way. He took the letter of the last of August, still sealed, and gave you Anne's, written the Sunday after you left, and a parcel from Henley Street tied with a knot of great confidence. You read her letter in the yard and again by the taproom window. It answers a letter she has not yet had. You did not open the parcel.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the sealed letter, read hers twice, and left the parcel tied.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote it the Sunday after he left. She has not yet had the last of August.
